project.name: Predictive Maintenance Platform
project.description: Industrial IoT machine degradation monitoring, FFT spectral kurtosis extraction, Deep Autoencoder anomaly scoring, and Weibull RUL estimation.

nodes.name: Industrial IoT Sensor Ingress
nodes.summary: Ingests continuous 1000Hz vibration, temperature, pressure, and acoustic sensor telemetry from plant manufacturing equipment.
outputs: Structured Telemetry Packet (Timestamp, Sensor ID, Value)

nodes.name: FastAPI Ingestion Gateway
nodes.summary: Validates device authentication certificates, performs schema normalization, and buffers readings into high-throughput queue.

nodes.name: FFT Spectral & Feature Extractor
nodes.tech: SciPy FFT · Fast Fourier Transform · Kurtosis
nodes.summary: Converts raw time-series vibration waveforms into frequency-domain power spectrums, extracting peak harmonics, skewness, and crest factors.

nodes.name: Deep Autoencoder Anomaly Scorer
nodes.summary: Trained on nominal healthy machine baselines; flags early mechanical degradation by measuring reconstruction error spikes.

nodes.name: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Forecaster
nodes.summary: Projects bearing and motor wear curves to estimate Remaining Useful Life (RUL) in operational hours before catastrophic failure.

nodes.name: TimescaleDB Time-Series Archive
nodes.summary: High-density partitioned time-series storage preserving billions of historical sensor readings with automated downsampling chunks.

nodes.name: Automated Maintenance Dispatch
nodes.summary: Automatically synthesizes and routes emergency work orders, replacement parts lists, and technician alerts upon failure detection.

nodes.name: Emergency Machine Shutdown Relay
nodes.summary: Trips instantly when vibration velocity exceeds ISO 10816 Class IV critical danger limit (11.2 mm/s RMS), cutting motor power to prevent plant explosion.

nodes.name: Sensor Drift & Disconnect Filter
nodes.summary: Filters out false alarms caused by detached probes or ADC wiring faults (e.g. static flatline 0.00V readings or impossible physical jumps).
outputs: Valid Telemetry Flag / Probe Fault Warning

layers.name: Ingress & Gateway Layer
layers.description: External client HUDs, edge authentication, and API endpoints.

layers.name: Core Engine & Orchestration Layer
layers.description: Autonomous loops, deterministic classifiers, and execution pipelines.

layers.name: State & Data Persistence Layer
layers.description: Relational tables, vector embeddings, caches, and time-series archives.

layers.name: Circuit Breakers & Defensive Guardrails Layer
layers.description: Defensive circuit breakers, kill switches, and anti-cheat traps.
